history.summary: 3BR at The Trilinq, a large 2017 D05 Clementi development 670m from the future CR17 Clementi (Cross Island Line) station, $1.88M at $1,695 PSF — ~7% below the $1,814 URA median. Dominant arena record (477-91-1, Elo 1804) and deep 243-txn data, but appreciation is a modest 3.0%/yr.
history.rating_rationale: Strong, reliable fundamentals: $1,695 PSF is ~7% under median, 243-txn data is robust, and 670m to the CRL Clementi interchange (~2030) is a real catalyst for a 2017 leasehold (~91yrs). The 1109sqft 3BR at $1.88M sits in a reasonable family band for D05's one-north/NUS catchment. The only soft spot is the 3.0%/yr historical appreciation — below OCR/RCR baselines — but the CRL uplift and below-median entry tilt this to a measured Buy. Large development = good liquidity.
red_flags: Modest 3.0%/yr historical appreciation — relies on CRL catalyst to lift
catalysts: Priced ~7% below URA median; deep 243-txn liquidity

history.summary: Well-located D05 (Clementi/Buona Vista) leasehold 1BR priced at $1,738 psf, essentially in line with the verified project average of ~$1,768 psf — fairly priced, not the discount the dossier suggests.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified recent transactions average ~$1,768 psf (last 12mo), so the $1,738 asking is only ~2% below market — at-market, not a bargain. The algo's age_adj_premium of -7.5% is modest and consistent with this near-market read (243 txns deep, psf_cohort 16 txns, so the data is reliable here — no quirk). The asset is genuinely good: D05 near Buona Vista/one-north/Clementi, large 755-unit liquid development, near NUS and the science/business parks for rental. But at a sub-3% likely yield on a ~$1.05M 1BR with no verified discount and only a baseline 3.01% trailing CAGR, there's no margin of safety to push past Neutral. A solid hold-quality unit at a fair price, not a value buy.
red_flags: Asking ~$1,738 psf is at-market vs verified ~$1,768 avg — no real discount
High ~$1.05M quantum for a 1BR compresses rental yield
99-yr lease from ~2013 — lease decay over a long hold
catalysts: D05 proximity to one-north / Buona Vista / NUS supports durable rental demand
Large, liquid development eases resale exit
